reason: The case asserts custom initializer-error detail contents through custom1.detail(), custom2.detail(), multiple1.detail() and multiple2.detail(). The error detail langlib operation is outside the explicit supported langlib lists, so the whole case is a feature even though its class constructors and named/default/rest arguments are supported.
